title: AVs Pack
body:
A Texture Pack for my channel!!!!!!! A work in progress because I am going to add so much more.\
This is a resource pack that changes the colors of:
1. **Redstone**(**Not Dust**)
2. Some **Mobs**
3. Some **Flowers** and **Items** 
4. Some **Paintings**
5. It also changes the **Hearts** to **Party Pink** and the **Crosshair** to **Ghouls Gold** as well as making it **Square** and **Smaller**\
This is so they fit with my theme. If you like the color pink this is the pack for you! I will add more in the future but at the moment this is it, enjoy!
